description.ja: 『魔神創造伝ワタル』より雷神丸が登場！
風神丸と対になるような姿をしている、御羅院が乗りこむ魔神！
description.en: A demon god that Gorain rides, which looks like a counterpart to Fujinmaru!

description.ja: • 部位ごとにパーツを分けられるシリーズ共通フレームを採用。他の魔神と組み合わせて遊ぼう！
description.en: • Adopts a common frame across the series that allows parts to be separated by area. Let's play in combination with other genies!

description.ja: • パチパチと手で外せるタッチゲート仕様。接着剤無しで組み立てられる！
description.en: • Touch gate design that can be removed by hand. Can be assembled without adhesive!

description.ja: • 背部の雷神の鼓や、雷鳴剣はクリアパーツで再現！
description.en: • The thunder god's drum and thunder sword on the back are reproduced with clear parts!

description.ja: • 2本の雷鳴剣は繋げて太刀へ変形可能！
description.en: • Two thunder swords can be connected and transformed into a long sword!
